Fixed authored material/tool categories, controlled attention, no natural cultural-emergence or scaling claim.

reception-result.json.fixture: NEW peaceful platform with a separate walled comparison chamber. Five original stationary NoAI adults. The listener/control start with native plains SVO and declared prior acquaintance with seven foreign word meanings, but no foreign receptive grammar; those lexical acquisitions are not claimed here. A real existing snowy/frozen/peaks founding vocabulary with distinct cues is selected and reported. A healthy foreign speaker visibly holds bread; a separate same-biome speaker starts with one native injury and a seeded compact OS copula convention; a native peer also visibly holds bread. Controlled public utterance opportunities obey each speaker's 200-tick dialogue budget. The listener hears full OVS, compact OS and native SVO from actual sounds plus public speaker-specific facts. The wall control has the same lexical priors but no visibility/exposure. No post-setup position, health, vocabulary, grammar or inventory setters; one actual interpreted food request causes a conserved production-code handoff. No existing society opened; no natural bilingual emergence, new semantic invention, visual UX or scaling claim.
